verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo on the green header like the original, but the dark card runs flush to the left and right edges, the can shrinks to a small object, and there are big dead areas above the can and below the CTA. B fills the card better with a larger can, but it pushes the logo to the bottom of the card and drops almost all of the green background, so it loses more of the original's look while still having flush side edges.

B keeps the original's structure: logo and a large can on the green, then a card holding the headline and CTA. Its only flaws are that the card bleeds off the bottom and sides and leaves some empty space below the button. A puts the can inside an oversized card with flush side edges, so the can becomes small and the layout opens large empty gaps around it.

A pushes the card off-centre and leaves a stray green strip on the right. Its headline, can and CTA are scattered to different corners on no shared axis, with a large empty void at mid-left, so the layout looks accidental. B is centred and orderly, though its card is flush to the side edges, its can is small and there is empty space below the CTA.
